instruction.name: x86clrtm
instruction.description: Clear the x87 translation mode, disabling TOP-based remapping of the FPRs.

throughput.name: 8 instructions per body
throughput.asm: x86clrtm; x86clrtm; x86clrtm; x86clrtm; x86clrtm; x86clrtm; x86clrtm; x86clrtm
throughput.command: ./bench --method slope --unroll 2000 --unroll2 8000 --iters 100 --warmup 10 --reps 10 --init 'li.d $r12, 5' --asm 'x86clrtm; x86clrtm; x86clrtm; x86clrtm; x86clrtm; x86clrtm; x86clrtm; x86clrtm'
throughput.notes: The instruction clears a global x87 mode bit, so copies serialise: six cycles per instruction regardless of how many are issued, measured at 7.00 for one copy and 28.00 for four.

notes: The instruction clears a global x87 mode bit, so copies serialise: six cycles per instruction regardless of how many are issued, measured at 7.00 for one copy and 28.00 for four. The instruction has no register operands, so no latency entry can be attached to one; the chain is over internal x87 state.
